t: Around you is Soho Square, a garden square that has served as a de facto public park since 1954. It was first called King Square, after Charles II, and a much weathered statue of the king has stood here, with a long interruption, since 1661. The square has some famous former residents. Sir Joseph Banks, the naturalist and botanist, lived here, as did his sister Sarah Sophia Banks, who collected coins, medals and ephemera that are now historically valuable, and his wife Dorothea, a collector of ceramics. The music publisher Thomas D'Almaine also lived on the square.
